summary: A large anchored e2 certificate for a left-right cross block need not survive completion of the corresponding full indefinite physical pair when arbitrary same-side anchor couplings are present. The target-valid 6x6 matrix in the canonical report has spectrum {-2,-1,0,0,1,2}, left-right cross block I_3, cross-only anchored Schur e2=1, but true full-pair Schur cross block diag(1,0) and e2=0. This refutes only the naive cross-only-e2 -> true-pair-Schur-e2 splice; it does not refute QFORM or the anchored cross-block identity.
required_repair: Feed pair-log/aggregate-e2 receivers only with the true full quadratic-pair Schur cross block, or prove that the same-side correction which destroys that bank forces an alternate paid square/definite-pair/grouped-bank mechanism.
